about_the_game:
Etheria is a turn-based strategy RPG set in a virtual metropolis

In the wake of a global freezing catastrophe, human civilization teeters on the brink of collapse... To preserve the flame of civilization, humanity transfers their consciousness into the virtual world "Etheria".

In "Etheria", besides humans, there are Animus who can utilize Anima Power. The two species originally coexisted harmoniously in Etheria, until one day a disaster called "Genesis" began to corrupt the Animus, causing them to go berserk and threaten human lives. To combat Genesis, the Hyperlinker Union was established.

And you, as a Hyperlinker, will enter the virtual world to uncover the hidden truths of Etheria.

[3D Real-Time Rendering, an Immersive Audio-Visual Feast]
Etheria is built with Unreal Engine, featuring realistic lighting details and real-time rendered in-game cutscenes for a cinematic immersive experience. In actual combat, each character has exclusive battle animations. The dynamic camera work and dazzling battle effects complement each other perfectly, providing an exhilarating combat experience without overwhelming visual clutter!

[Strategic Turn-Based Battles, Endless Team Combinations]
Etheria builds upon classic turn-based combat, combining various strategic mechanisms and compact, intricately designed levels to create a next-generation Team RPG gameplay experience! In battles, players can form countless team combinations based on the Animus' skills. You can also command battles in real-time, freely controlling each Animus' actions, and experience the strategic thrill of overcoming stronger opponents through various skill synergies and tactical setups.

[Strategic Competitive Contests, Unleash the Heat of Battle Now!]
Enter the Arena! Here, one-on-one duels are held non-stop, unleashing thrilling PVP battles amidst passionate cheers! Showcase your unique strategies to other Hyperlinkers, enjoy the purest intellectual competition, and realize your dream of heated battles!

[Delve Deep into the Threshold and Confront the Infected Head-On]
The world of Etheria offers rich PVE content. The powerful enemies encountered in the Main Quest will reappear in the Threshold, GP Outpost, and Investigations. Team up with your Animus squad to defeat these bosses! Of course, powerful Hyperlinkers won't be satisfied with just this. Venture deeper into the Ruins, where more dangerous and mysterious enemies await your challenge...

[Unleash Hyperlink Abilities, Craft Your Unique Combat Style]
Each Animus has its own exclusive Prowess system, offering diverse development options. Freely train and equip Shells, combine nearly a hundred different Ether Module sets to alter an Animus' combat style or even class. Tailor specialized strategies for your favorite Animus to tackle different battle situations!

[Link with the Animus, Find Your Mysterious Partners]
In this virtual metropolis where danger and opportunity coexist, the journey of a Hyperlinker is destined not to be lonely! You'll encounter hundreds of Animus: a dual-wielding grim reaper carrying a heavy coffin, a punk-dressed genius hacker, a Metropolitan Empress skilled in extracting Soul Flames... In the conspiracy-ridden world of Etheria, join forces to confront unknown powers and unveil the mysteries of this futuristic metropolis."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 660Ti or AMD R9 270 with 2+ GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX2070 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
